newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas trade focused in Q2 98, June set to roll.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas trade focused in Q2 98, June set to roll.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures climbed in the second quarter next year in the morning session on Thursday, while the front month June, which expires at the close of business, was untraded.
A total of 20 lots were traded in the second quarter on 1998. April climbed 0.230 pence per therm (p/th) to 11.70 p/th, while May gained 0.260 to 11.30 p/th.
Bids and offer were posted across summer 1997 with levels little changed from Wednesday.
June was bid at 11.15 p/th, having settled at 11.20 p/th, but no offers were seen.

Open interest on June at the end of trading on Wednesday was 185 lots, equivalent to 185,000 therms a day, or 5,550,000 therms over the whole month. The size of the physical delivery against the expired contract will be released on Friday, an IPE spokeswoman said.
